947: function updateDragCar(d, car, dt, throttle, stats) {
948:   if (!car.launched) {
949:     car.rpm = 900 + (throttle ? 4300 + Math.sin(game.t * 40) * 160 : 0)
950:     return
951:   }
952:   const gearMax = dragGearMax(car, stats)
953:   car.rpm = clamp(820 + (car.speed / gearMax) * 6800, 780, 7900)
954:   car.shiftT = Math.max(0, car.shiftT - dt)
955:   car.boost = Math.max(0, car.boost - dt)
956:   let nitroOn = false
957:   if (car.nitroT > 0) {
958:     car.nitroT = Math.max(0, car.nitroT - dt)
959:     nitroOn = true
960:   }
961: 
962:   if (throttle && car.shiftT <= 0) {
963:     if (car.rpm < REDLINE + 20) {
964:       const t = clamp(car.speed / gearMax, 0, 1)
965:       const falloff = 1 - Math.pow(t, 2.4) * 0.64
966:       let accel = (92 + stats.acc * 16) * GEAR_TORQUE[car.gear] * falloff
967:       if (car.boost > 0) accel += 85
968:       if (nitroOn) accel += 185
969:       car.speed += accel * dt
970:     } else {
971:       car.speed = Math.max(0, car.speed - 28 * dt)
972:       if (Math.random() < dt * 14) {
973:         spawnParticle(d.particles, car.x + rand(-8, 8), car.y + 22, rand(-30, 30), rand(20, 80), 0.4, 2, '#ffd34e', 2)
974:       }
975:     }
976:   } else if (!throttle) {
977:     car.speed = Math.max(0, car.speed - 30 * dt)
978:   }
979:   if (car.shiftT > 0) car.speed = Math.max(0, car.speed - 24 * dt)
980: 
981:   // Drag and gear cap.
982:   car.speed -= car.speed * 0.045 * dt
983:   const cap = gearMax * (nitroOn ? 1.18 : 1.02)
984:   if (car.speed > cap) car.speed = cap
985:   if (car.speed < 0) car.speed = 0
986: 
987:   car.distance += car.speed * dt
988:   car.y = DRAG.startY - car.distance
989: 
990:   // Wheelspin smoke.
991:   if (car.speed < 55 && throttle) {
992:     car.wheelspin += dt
993:     if (Math.random() < dt * 34) {
994:       spawnParticle(d.particles, car.x + rand(-10, 10), car.y + 18, rand(-24, 24), rand(10, 55), rand(0.35, 0.8), 2, Math.random() > 0.4 ? '#d0c9dc' : '#8e86a8', 5)
995:     }

999:   }

1048: function updateDrag(dt) {
1049:   const d = game.drag
1050:   if (!d) return
1051:   if (d.phase === 'done') {
1052:     if (input.consume('confirm') || input.consume('space')) {
1053:       sound.select()
1054:       setScreen('drag')
1055:     } else if (input.consume('pause')) {
1056:       sound.back()
1057:       setScreen('menu')
1058:     }
1059:     if (game.toast) game.toast.t -= dt
1060:     return
1061:   }
1062: 
1063:   d.shiftMsgT = Math.max(0, d.shiftMsgT - dt)
1064:   d.falseMsgT = Math.max(0, d.falseMsgT - dt)
1065:   d.shake = Math.max(0, d.shake - dt * 18)
1066:   game.flash = Math.max(0, game.flash - dt * 2.5)
1067:   updateParticles(d.particles, dt)
1068: 
1069:   if (d.phase === 'count') {
1070:     d.phaseT += dt
1071:     const p = d.player
1072:     p.rpm = 900 + (input.heldAny('up', 'throttle') ? 4300 + Math.sin(game.t * 42) * 180 : 0)
1073:     // Jump start.
1074:     if (!d.falseStart && input.heldAny('up', 'throttle')) {
1075:       d.falseStart = true
1076:       d.falseMsgT = 2.2
1077:       sound.fail()
1078:     }
1079:     const lightTimes = [0.6, 1.1, 1.6]
1080:     for (let i = 0; i < lightTimes.length; i++) {
1081:       if (d.phaseT >= lightTimes[i] && !d['l' + i]) {
1082:         d['l' + i] = true
1083:         sound.countdown(i + 1)
1084:       }
1085:     }
1086:     if (d.phaseT >= 2.25) {
1087:       d.phase = 'run'
1088:       d.green = true
1089:       d.goT = 0
1090:       d.lightsOn = true
1091:       sound.countdown(0)
1092:       d.opp.launched = false
1093:     }
1094:     sound.engine(p.rpm / 8000, 0.45, true)
1095:     sound.tire(0)
1096:     return
1097:   }
1098: 
1099:   // Race running.
1100:   d.goT += dt
1101:   const p = d.player
1102:   const o = d.opp
1103:   const throttle = input.heldAny('up', 'throttle')
1104:   const pStats = d.playerStats
1105: 
1106:   if (!p.launched) {
1107:     if (!d.falseStart && throttle) {
1108:       p.launched = true
1109:       p.launchAt = d.goT
1110:       d.shake = 3
1111:       d.launchFlash = 0.4
1112:       for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
1113:         spawnParticle(d.particles, p.x + rand(-13, 13), p.y + 19, rand(-40, 40), rand(20, 90), rand(0.4, 1.0), 2, '#cfc8dd', 5)
1114:       }
1115:       sound.shift(true)
1116:     } else if (d.falseStart && d.goT > 0.9) {
1117:       p.launched = true
1118:       p.launchAt = d.goT
1119:       d.shake = 2
1120:       for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
1121:         spawnParticle(d.particles, p.x + rand(-13, 13), p.y + 19, rand(-40, 40), rand(20, 90), rand(0.4, 1.0), 2, '#cfc8dd', 4)
1122:       }
1123:     }
1124:   }
1125: 
1126:   if (o.launched && o.distance >= d.track.distance) {
1127:     // already finished
1128:   } else if (!o.launched && d.goT > o.launchDelay) {
1129:     o.launched = true
1130:     for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
1131:       spawnParticle(d.particles, o.x + rand(-13, 13), o.y + 19, rand(-30, 30), rand(20, 70), rand(0.3, 0.7), 2, '#cfc8dd', 4)
1132:     }
1133:   }
1134: 
1135:   // Input.
1136:   if (input.consume('space') || input.consume('shift')) playerShift()
1137:   if (input.consume('nitro') && !p.nitroUsed && p.launched) {
1138:     p.nitroUsed = true
1139:     p.nitroT = 2.15
1140:     d.shiftMsg = 'NITRO!'
1141:     d.shiftMsgT = 1.0
1142:     sound.nitroWhoosh()
1143:   }
1144: 
1145:   updateDragCar(d, p, dt, throttle, pStats)
1146:   updateDragCar(d, o, dt, o.launched, d.oppStats)
1147:   if (o.launched) oppShift(d)
1148: 
1149:   // Stamp a little launch rubber.
1150:   if (p.launched && p.distance < 70 && game.skid) {
1151:     const sg = game.skid.getContext('2d')
1152:     sg.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,6,14,0.45)'
1153:     sg.fillRect(Math.round(p.x - 11), Math.round(p.y + 14), 3, 5)
1154:     sg.fillRect(Math.round(p.x + 8), Math.round(p.y + 14), 3, 5)
1155:   }
1156: 
1157:   // Finish detection.
1158:   if (!p.finished && p.distance >= d.track.distance) {
1159:     p.finished = true
1160:     p.finishTime = d.goT
1161:     d.firstFinish = d.firstFinish || d.goT
1162:     game.flash = 0.35
1163:     game.flashColor = '67,246,224'
1164:   }
1165:   if (!o.finished && o.distance >= d.track.distance) {
1166:     o.finished = true
1167:     o.finishTime = d.goT
1168:     d.firstFinish = d.firstFinish || d.goT
1169:     if (!p.finished) {
1170:       game.flash = 0.25
1171:       game.flashColor = '255,61,127'
1172:     }
1173:   }
1174: 
1175:   const bothDone = p.finished && o.finished
1176:   const waited = p.finished && d.goT - p.finishTime > 2.0
1177:   const stalled = !p.launched && d.goT > 4.5
1178:   const timeout = d.goT > 30
1179:   if (bothDone || waited || stalled || timeout) {
1180:     finishDrag(d)
1181:   }
1182: 
1183:   // Car audio.
1184:   const rpmN = clamp(p.rpm / 8000, 0, 1)
1185:   sound.engine(rpmN, p.launched ? 0.8 : 0.4, true)
1186:   sound.tire(p.launched && p.speed < 70 && throttle ? 0.5 : 0)
1187:   sound.nitro(p.nitroT > 0)

404: function catmullRomClosed(points, perSeg = 24) {
405:   const out = []
406:   const n = points.length
407:   for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
408:     const p0 = points[(i - 1 + n) % n]
409:     const p1 = points[i]
410:     const p2 = points[(i + 1) % n]
411:     const p3 = points[(i + 2) % n]
412:     for (let j = 0; j < perSeg; j++) {
413:       const t = j / perSeg
414:       const t2 = t * t
415:       const t3 = t2 * t
416:       const x = 0.5 * ((2 * p1[0]) + (-p0[0] + p2[0]) * t + (2 * p0[0] - 5 * p1[0] + 4 * p2[0] - p3[0]) * t2 + (-p0[0] + 3 * p1[0] - 3 * p2[0] + p3[0]) * t3)
417:       const y = 0.5 * ((2 * p1[1]) + (-p0[1] + p2[1]) * t + (2 * p0[1] - 5 * p1[1] + 4 * p2[1] - p3[1]) * t2 + (-p0[1] + 3 * p1[1] - 3 * p2[1] + p3[1]) * t3)
418:       out.push({ x, y })
419:     }
420:   }
421:   return out
422: }

491: export function buildDriftWorld() {
492:   const halfWidth = 70
493:   const margin = 120
494:   let points = catmullRomClosed(DRIFT_CONTROL, 24)
495:   let minX = Infinity
496:   let minY = Infinity
497:   let maxX = -Infinity
498:   let maxY = -Infinity
499:   for (const p of points) {
500:     minX = Math.min(minX, p.x)
501:     minY = Math.min(minY, p.y)
502:     maxX = Math.max(maxX, p.x)
503:     maxY = Math.max(maxY, p.y)
504:   }
505:   const offsetX = -minX + margin
506:   const offsetY = -minY + margin
507:   const width = Math.ceil(maxX - minX + margin * 2)
508:   const height = Math.ceil(maxY - minY + margin * 2)
509:   points = points.map((p) => ({ x: p.x + offsetX, y: p.y + offsetY }))
510: 
511:   const samples = points.map((p, i) => {
512:     const prev = points[(i - 1 + points.length) % points.length]
513:     const next = points[(i + 1) % points.length]
514:     const dx = next.x - prev.x
515:     const dy = next.y - prev.y
516:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1
517:     return {
518:       x: p.x,
519:       y: p.y,
520:       tx: dx / len,
521:       ty: dy / len,
522:       nx: -dy / len,
523:       ny: dx / len,
524:       angle: Math.atan2(dy, dx),
525:       index: i,

529:   const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')

531:   canvas.height = height

533:   const rnd = seeded(4242)

538:   g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(67,246,224,0.035)'
539:   g.lineWidth = 1
540:   for (let x = 0; x < width; x += 36) {
541:     g.beginPath()
542:     g.moveTo(x, 0)
543:     g.lineTo(x, height)
544:     g.stroke()
545:   }
546:   for (let y = 0; y < height; y += 36) {
547:     g.beginPath()
548:     g.moveTo(0, y)
549:     g.lineTo(width, y)
550:     g.stroke()
551:   }
552:   // Ground debris / glints.
553:   for (let i = 0; i < 420; i++) {
554:     const x = Math.floor(rnd() * width)
555:     const y = Math.floor(rnd() * height)

560:   // Track aura and asphalt.
561:   strokeTrack(g, samples, 156, 'rgba(255,61,127,0.06)')
562:   strokeTrack(g, samples, 144, 'rgba(67,246,224,0.08)')
563:   strokeTrack(g, samples, 134, '#100b1c')

566:   strokeTrack(g, samples, 130, '#ff3d7f', [13, 13], 13)

573:   g.moveTo(samples[0].x, samples[0].y)

575:   g.closePath()
576:   g.lineWidth = 110
577:   g.strokeStyle = '#2a2638'
578:   g.stroke()
579:   g.clip()
580:   for (let i = 0; i < 900; i++) {
581:     const s = samples[Math.floor(rnd() * samples.length)]
582:     const off = (rnd() - 0.5) * 104
583:     const x = s.x + s.nx * off
584:     const y = s.y + s.ny * off
585:     g.fillStyle = rnd() > 0.93 ? 'rgba(255,61,127,0.15)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.035)'
586:     g.fillRect(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), 1, 1)
